Ranks all Montgomery census tracts by their pre-aggregated 2025 311 service request total, left-joining tract counts to the tract list so missing tracts show zero, with geoid last for mapping.
sql:
WITH tract_totals AS (
  SELECT geoid, n
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_352bd4'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
)
SELECT
  t.name,
  COALESCE(tt.n, 0) AS service_request_count,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN tract_totals tt ON tt.geoid = t.geoid
WHERE t.geoid IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY service_request_count DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
